title.value: Multi-scale Digital Twin: Developing a fast and physics-informed surrogate model for groundwater contamination with uncertain climate models
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the start of the document along with the authors' information.
title.quote: Multi-scale Digital Twin: Developing a fast and physics-informed surrogate model for groundwater contamination with uncertain climate models

extractions.description: The paper presents a multi-scale digital twin model using machine learning and physics-informed approaches to predict groundwater contamination under uncertain climate scenarios. U-Net enhanced Fourier Neural Operator (U-FNO) and neural operator learning are utilized to solve PDEs for complex flow and transport simulations. The model incorporates multi-scale uncertainties in physical simulations, climate data clustering, and provides a surrogate model for real-time predictions to assist in site management and decision-making in response to climate changes.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on groundwater contamination and its exacerbation due to climate change. It aims to improve environmental remediation and climate resilience by using advanced modeling techniques.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Climate change exacerbates the long-term site management problem because extreme precipitation and/or shifts in precipitation/evapotranspiration regimes could re-mobilize contaminants and proliferate affected groundwater.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on adapting to climate change impacts on groundwater contamination, offering predictive models to assess spatiotemporal variations and manage affected sites better.
primary_category.quote: To quickly assess the spatiotemporal variations of groundwater contamination under uncertain climate disturbances, we developed a physics-informed machine learning surrogate model...

secondary_categories.justification: The paper involves modeling and predicting the impacts of climate change, specifically focusing on evaluating climate data and uncertainties.
secondary_categories.quote: In this paper, we integrate the recent advances in machine learning (ML) and physical simulation to predict the spatiotemporal dynamics of the subsurface contamination under future climate changes for decision-makers and site managers.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper addresses soil and groundwater contamination, a form of chemical pollution, by developing techniques to predict and manage these pollutants under varying climate conditions.
secondary_categories.quote: Soil and groundwater contamination is a pervasive problem at thousands of locations across the world.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper develops models that predict the impacts of climate change on groundwater contamination, an essential component of understanding and managing climate risks.
primary_sub_category.quote: To quickly assess the spatiotemporal variations of groundwater contamination under uncertain climate disturbances, we developed a physics-informed machine learning surrogate model...

secondary_sub_categories.justification: While the primary focus is not directly on GHGs, the relationship between climate projections and contamination encompasses aspects of climate science related to emissions and temperature impacts.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: We incorporate multi-scale uncertainties in physical simulations: uncertain global climate projections and uncertain local soil and subsurface properties.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper's focus on groundwater contamination directly relates to chemical pollution and the need to predict and manage these pollutants under climate change.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Soil and groundwater contamination is a pervasive problem at thousands of locations across the world.

applications.value: Predicting groundwater contamination under climate change impacts
applications.justification: The main application of the study is developing a model that predicts groundwater contamination dynamics under uncertain climate changes to assist in decision-making for site management.
applications.quote: This Multi-scale Digital Twin work can advance the field of environmental remediation under climate change.

applications.value: Climate data clustering for better predictions
applications.justification: The study includes an application of clustering climate data to produce a more manageable set of inputs for the surrogate modeling, enhancing the prediction reliability.
applications.quote: The ML-based unique climate clusters provide climate projections for the surrogate modeling and help return reliable future recharge rate projections immediately without querying large climate datasets.
